buses.CODE: chart-recent, chart-history, chart-rebased, chart-fvw, chart-cmp, groups, kpi:level, kpi:fuel — selects the bus general index, its main groups, fuel and drivers' wages
buses.NAME_HE: groups, insight:drivers — CBS's label, shown for a code the recipe has no short label for
buses.FREQ: skip: constant M (the resource is fetched monthly only); rows of any other frequency are dropped
buses.DATE: chart-recent, chart-compare, chart-history, chart-rebased, chart-fvw, chart-cmp, groups
buses.TIME_PERIOD: skip: the same month as DATE in another form
buses.VALUE: recent, kpi:level — the published value on its own base
buses.BASE_DESC: kpi:level — the base of the latest published value
buses.PERCENT: chart-recent, groups, kpi:mom, insight:latest, insight:biggest_month — and the chain re-link check
buses.PERCENT_YEAR: chart-recent, chart-fvw, chart-cmp, groups, kpi:yoy, kpi:fuel, insight:latest, insight:three_way, insight:fuel_wages, insight:drivers, insight:yoy_trend
buses.VALUE_CHAINED: chart-history, chart-compare, chart-rebased, groups, insight:since — every month on the newest base
buses.CHAIN_BASE: chart-history — names the base of the chained series

lines.TIME_PERIOD: skip: the same month as DATE in another form
lines.VALUE: skip: shown through VALUE_CHAINED and the published changes

lines.CHAIN_BASE: skip: the series is shown rebased to the common start
